Deep inside the Parthenon building in Nashville stands a towering idol from ancient mythology. Over a century ago, a startling dream was given to a woman in 1904 about a fireball from heaven striking this very structure.

Could that dream be coming true? Just two weeks ago, people across the southeastern U.S. witnessed real fireballs falling from the sky, caught on camera.

We take you inside the Parthenon, revealing the shocking symbolism, and connect it all to a mysterious prophecy that may be unfolding before our eyes. What could this mean for Nashville? Tell us what YOU think.
